name: John Han
office: City of Arcadia, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: John Han was appointed to the Arcadia City Council for District 3 on June 16, 2026, to serve the remainder of a term that expires in November 2026. He is a self-employed investment manager.

sentences.text: John Han was appointed to the Arcadia City Council for District 3 on June 16, 2026, to serve the remainder of a term that expires in November 2026.
He is a self-employed investment manager.

items.text: His campaign website lists priorities of defending public safety by backing police and firefighters, managing taxpayer dollars with discipline and transparency, and engaging residents on community priorities. In his first council meeting he voted to approve the city’s $100.1 million budget, a multi-family development project, and new refuse and recycling rates. He was later named to co-lead a new Micro-Mobility Subcommittee focused on updating local municipal codes to establish clear rules.
